summary: Read the complete 31-page markdown conversion through the references and publisher note; no appendix or separate supplement was identified. Checked all six estimates against every cited source page and inspected Figures 2 and 6 in memory. All recorded numerical statistics and project counts match the PDF and belong to the stated comparison. Participant counts for the project analysis are not printed, so null is appropriate. The five dimension-specific records correctly leave arm summaries and uncertainty null. Two coding corrections concern the overall design-quality score. The remaining requested estimate codes are supported, and no in-scope outcome or contrast is missing. The extraction already flags unreported instructional-cluster replication; core eligibility remains unresolved.
